shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin surged past $80,000, extending a post-Fed rally, with the total crypto market cap up over 2.2% to $2.66T and the Crypto Fear & Greed Index rising to 56 (Greed).
The CLARITY Act stalled in the Senate, but the SEC granted a conditional exemption for tokenized stock trading, boosting DeFi tokens.
The Federal Reserve hiked rates for the first time in 3 years with a hawkish stance, suggesting no easing through 2027, potentially tightening financial conditions.
President Trump signed a law for potential 500% tariffs on Russian goods by Oct 18, risking energy inflation and tighter financial conditions.
Layer-2 and DeFi tokens like Uniswap and Arbitrum saw significant gains, though Nostra was exploited for $3.5M.
